import random, socket, struct, subprocess, sys
def load_fib(path):
    d = {}
    for line in open(path):
        toks = [t for t in line.replace('\t',' ').replace('\r',' ').split(' ') if t]
        if not toks: continue
        spec, hop = toks[0], int(toks[1])
        addr, ln = spec.rsplit('/', 1); ln = int(ln)
        b = socket.inet_pton(socket.AF_INET6, addr)
        upper = struct.unpack(">Q", b[:8])[0]
        start = 0 if ln == 0 else upper & ((((1<<ln)-1) << (64-ln)) & ((1<<64)-1))
        assert (start, ln) not in d
        d[(start, ln)] = hop
    return d
def lpm(d, key):
    for ln in range(64, -1, -1):
        m = 0 if ln == 0 else key & ((((1<<ln)-1) << (64-ln)) & ((1<<64)-1))
        if (m, ln) in d: return (d[(m, ln)], ln)
    return (-1, -1)
d = load_fib('deep.txt')
rng = random.Random(99)
keys = [rng.getrandbits(64) for _ in range(400)]
for (s, ln) in list(d)[:100]:
    keys.append(s); keys.append((s + (1 << (64-ln)) - 1) & ((1<<64)-1) if ln < 64 else s)
with open('deep_tr2.txt','w') as f:
    for k in keys:
        w = [(k>>48)&0xffff,(k>>32)&0xffff,(k>>16)&0xffff,k&0xffff,0,0,0,0]
        f.write(':'.join('%x'%x for x in w) + '\n')
want = ''.join('%d %d\n' % lpm(d, k) for k in keys)
for mode in ('scalar','batch 13','batch 256'):
    p = subprocess.run(['/work/submit/planb64','lookup','deep.idx','deep_tr2.txt']+mode.split(), capture_output=True)
    assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr
    assert p.stdout.decode() == want, "MISMATCH " + mode
